verdict.rationale: AWS exposes a comprehensive, well-documented public API surface (AWS CLI, SDKs, CloudFormation, CDK) plus IAM-based programmatic auth (roles, OIDC, temporary credentials) allowing full driving of the product without a human UI, and there's an llms.txt structured docs endpoint confirming machine-readability. Missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec was found (404s on standard paths), so full machine-readable API schema discovery is not directly evidenced.
